{{Top|leg}}
'''Velvoid''' was a [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] material. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] kept numerous articles of<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref> expensive and tasteful semiformal [[Clothing/Legends|shipclothing]]<ref name="Flamewind of Oseon">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref> made from this fabric in his wardrobe, including mauve semiformals, a dark vest,<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu" /> and a cummerbund.<ref name="Flamewind of Oseon" /> Calrissian was given a borrowed purple velvoid bathrobe by [[Duttes Mer]] after an incident at [[Hotel Sharu]], though Calrissian considered this particular item to be in egregious taste, and mused that he would have to reassess his entire wardrobe if everyone took to wearing velvoid.<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu" /> He later encountered [[Bohhuah Mutdah/Legends|Bohhuah Mutdah]], who wore purple velvoid shorts.<ref name="Flamewind of Oseon" />
